# Path rules of the adapter server file test (.github/scripts/ci_changes.py
# prints adapterfile=true when a changed path matches one): the code the file
# runs, its build script and test, the install script, the lock file and the
# shared CI files. One fnmatch pattern per line on the repository path, where
# * also matches /.

tools/deploy/canworks/diag.py
tools/deploy/canworks/localbus/*
tools/deploy/canworks/link/*
tools/deploy/canworks/__init__.py
tools/deploy/pyproject.toml
tools/deploy/uv.lock
tools/deploy/tests/test_adapter_file.py
scripts/build-adapter-pyz.py
scripts/install-adapter.sh
.github/*
